analysisBpmRange.label: BPM analysis range
analysisBpmRange.dialogHint: The range determines half/double-time interpretation and is also used for future idle analysis.
analysisBpmRange.settingsHint: A narrower range prevents half/double-time ambiguity. Results always stay inside the selected range.
analysisBpmRange.settingsScopeHint: Changes affect newly queued and reanalyzed tracks only; existing results are unchanged.

curatedArtistTracking.title: Curated artist tracking
curatedArtistTracking.desc: When a track is added to Curated, remember its artist together with the related track fingerprints. Matching artists in Filter get a soft gold highlight, and these records also take part in cloud sync.
curatedArtistTracking.managerDesc: This list shows every curated artist stored in the current library. You can search, sort, and add, edit, or delete entries manually.
curatedArtistTracking.managerValidationPlaceholder: Artist names must stay non-empty and unique.
curatedArtistTracking.managerAddedCountTitle: "{artist}" has been added to Curated {count} times
curatedArtistTracking.managerEmpty: No curated artists are recorded yet. Add one from the top-right button.
curatedArtistTracking.managerDeleteConfirmHint: This will not delete tracks or change the Curated library contents.
curatedArtistTracking.managerSaveFailed: Failed to save the curated artist list
curatedArtistTracking.clearDesc: {count} curated artists are recorded in the current library.
curatedArtistTracking.emptyHint: No curated artists have been recorded in the current library yet.
curatedArtistTracking.clearConfirmLine1: This will clear the curated artist list stored in the current library.
curatedArtistTracking.clearConfirmLine2: It will not delete tracks or change the Curated library contents. Continue?
curatedArtistTracking.clearSuccess: The curated artist list has been cleared.
curatedArtistTracking.clearFailed: Failed to clear the curated artist list
curatedArtistTracking.importProgressLoadTree: Importing curated artists: loading the external playlist tree...
curatedArtistTracking.importProgressLoadPlaylists: Importing curated artists: loading playlist tracks...

clearDirtyData.title: Clean Dirty Library Data (Dev/Prerelease only)
clearDirtyData.desc: Keeps songs, playlists/tree, fingerprints, settings and recycle-bin records; clears analysis and Mixtape Auto-Recording related data/caches.
clearDirtyData.confirmLine1: This will clear analysis results, Mixtape Auto-Recording playlist data, and related caches in the current library.
clearDirtyData.confirmLine2: Songs, playlists/tree, fingerprints, settings, and recycle-bin records will be kept. Continue?
clearDirtyData.successLine2: Deleted {sqliteRows} SQLite rows, removed {libraryItems} library cache items, and removed {userDataItems} userData cache items.

clearAnalysisRuntime.title: Clear Local Analysis Runtime (Dev/Prerelease only)
clearAnalysisRuntime.desc: Remove the downloaded runtime, the download cache, and any writable built-in runtime* directories under the current app. After clearing, the app behaves like a fresh install that has never downloaded a runtime.
clearAnalysisRuntime.confirmLine1: This will delete the local downloaded runtime, the download cache, and any writable built-in runtime* directories under the current app.
clearAnalysisRuntime.confirmLine2: This clears the local downloaded runtime state. If the current app bundle or workspace still contains a usable built-in runtime, the app will not prompt for download again. Restarting afterwards is recommended.
clearAnalysisRuntime.successLine1: The local analysis runtime has been cleared.
clearAnalysisRuntime.successLine2: The downloaded runtime, the download cache, and {count} built-in runtime* directorie(s) were removed.
clearAnalysisRuntime.successLine3BundledAvailable: A usable built-in runtime is still present, so restarting will not show the download prompt again.
clearAnalysisRuntime.successLine3NeedsDownload: After restarting, the app will prompt again as if no runtime had ever been downloaded.
clearAnalysisRuntime.partialFailed: The local analysis runtime was not fully cleared.
clearAnalysisRuntime.partialFailedInstalledRoot: The runtime directory still exists. Some files may still be locked by the current process.
clearAnalysisRuntime.partialFailedBundledRuntimes: {count} built-in runtime* directorie(s) could not be removed.
clearAnalysisRuntime.partialFailedHint: Restart Track Studio and try again. If it still fails, check for processes that are holding the related files.
clearAnalysisRuntime.failed: Failed to clear the local analysis runtime

ultraStemModel.title: Ultra-quality Stem model
ultraStemModel.desc: Download it on demand from the Stem Workspace after choosing Ultra Quality. It stays after restart and can be removed at any time to free space.
ultraStemModel.statusNotInstalled: Not downloaded (download it in Stem Workspace)
ultraStemModel.removeConfirmLine1: This removes the local ultra-quality Stem model (about {size}).
ultraStemModel.removeConfirmLine2: Ultra Quality stays unavailable until it is downloaded again. Exported Stem files are not affected.
ultraStemModel.removeBusy: Wait for the active Stem separation or model download to finish before removing the model.
ultraStemModel.removeFailed: Failed to remove the ultra-quality model

layout.headerHint: Reordered by usage priority, with high-risk actions isolated at the end.
layout.quickNavDesc: Jump straight to the area you want instead of scrolling through a long list.
layout.instantApplyDesc: Except for dangerous actions, most settings are saved and applied immediately.
layout.summaryDesc: The settings most likely to be changed repeatedly are surfaced first.
layout.sectionCommonDesc: Theme, language, output device, and frequently changed basics stay here first.
layout.sectionPlaybackDesc: Player behavior, waveform display, and global shortcuts live in one place.
layout.sectionMetadataDesc: Manage AcoustID, fingerprint mode, and scan formats without extra hopping around.
layout.sectionLibraryDesc: Everything that affects list display, curated linkage, and music library actions is grouped here.
layout.sectionSafetyDesc: High-risk operations are isolated at the end to reduce accidental clicks.
